folds.heading: ## Full dials-palette reconciliation, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Use WDI41–WDI45 and B93 to qualify WDI1–WDI3: pack profiles/modules and injected fact types already existed; layer ordering and explicit exemptions differ from merely placing a cheat higher. A profile with no resolver can be dormant. An exported grammar or receipt shape does not establish an executed command, and exact rational arithmetic alone does not prove whole-consumer determinism. Preserve the named target-isolation/base/receipt issues at their inspected input rather than declaring a newly reproduced runtime failure.

WDI55 assumed saved fields for the first new meter; the later M3 result explicitly renders existing spirituality/strain state with no save change. Its code/tests and DOM readings do not close its own hidden-pane pixel and native save/reload/import gaps. WDI49 examples are behavior families, not laws that every digestion/lifespan track is monotone. WDI50 threshold consequences, WDI53 every-change logging, WDI54 dormant cross-world treatment and WDI61 one condition shape are proposals to fit actual mechanisms and owners, not universal resource rules (AD5, AD38). Hidden causes stay hidden even when a meter can explain an observed change.

Keep WDI61–WDI65 source distinctions: conditions on body/item/place can have different lifecycles; known unavailable verbs differ from undiscovered ones; creation-point budgets are optional world ideas; a consumer lint is not semantic completeness. The old FND5 second-world requirement is qualified by AD51, and old own-worktree lane language by AD41. Shared design can start from known needs and a first real consumer, with another distinct world validating it. No source acquisition, registry redesign, local AI interpreter, current lease or new implementation priority follows from this review.
